Bring Arah: 8 nurnies, 20 [[planklet]]s, and 4 [[beanjuice]] |location = [[Badgetown]] |Club = Hasn't joined a club because she's an independent spirit}} '''Arah''' is a [[character]] found in [[Ooblets (game)]]. She lives in [[Badgetown]]; her house is located beside the stairs leading to the [[Mossprouts]] Clubhouse and [[Badgetown Oobnet Tower]]. She operates the [[Printypress|Friendship Sticker Printypress]]. == Location == Early in the morning, Arah can be found standing outside her house. During the afternoon, she can be found inside the [[Lernery]], and at night she will return to her house. == Appearance == Arah's hair is dyed a dark black, as evidenced by the fact that her eyebrows are still her natural brown. She is a rather pale individual; the main accent piece that she wears are her thick-rimmed circular glasses, and the two mauve bands keeping her hair in side-buns. Her sweater is dark grey, accessorized with a brown satchel and a long necklace with a circular charm on the end of it. The jeans that she wears are torn at the knees & scuffed around the mid-thigh region. A more saturated purple color adorns her shoes, which have black treads. == Personality == Arah is a spunky sort of person who marches to the tune of her own drum. She has a very modern dialect, and is generally kind to everyone that she meets. She is particularly fixated on a more dark academia way of life, enjoying activities such as creating potions and spells alongside summoning the occult. She also enjoys meeting new people.''"My fave type of person—one I don't know yet."'' – [[Arah]] == Ooblets == Arah has one [[Ooblets|ooblet]]: a common [[Gloopy Long Legs]] File:Gloopylonglegs.png == Interactions == === [[Story of Ooblets (game)|Story]] === Upon arriving in [[Badgetown]], the Player will need to introduce themselves to some of the local residents, including Arah. She will remark: ''"Digging your whole dealie you got going on. Very confused-chic."''
